name: Panels
description: All-in-one plugin-based robot dashboard: OpMode control, telemetry, field view, graphs, capture and live configurables.

mavenRepositories.name: Dairy Foundation (Sloth, used by Panels for scanning as of SDK 12)

artifacts.description: Panels core with every official plugin

versions.notes: Panels' update guide requires FTC SDK 12.0.0 and both Maven repositories.

postInstall: Run a clean build after updating Panels so old Panels assets are not reused (FTC: Clean Build).
Do not mix com.bylazar:fullpanels with the individual Panels plugin artifacts.

sloth.note: The official com.bylazar artifacts support Sloth directly; the older com.bylazar.sloth artifacts are no longer needed.

conflicts.reason: Switch from the old com.bylazar.sloth artifacts to the official com.bylazar artifacts.
fullpanels already contains the Panels core; do not mix fullpanels with individual plugins.

upgradeNotes.text: Before updating: commit your code, update the FTC SDK to 12.0.0, make sure both the Bylazar and Dairy repositories are present, and do a clean build.
